consequence.statement: The CONNTRACK_LOCAL environment variable is deprecated and scheduled for removal in a future release; it currently still functions but operators should plan to remove its usage.

original.statement: The CONNTRACK_LOCAL environment variable has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release.

decision.reason: [ev-f941fa338b6a] says only that the `CONNTRACK_LOCAL` option has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It does not say anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured in 1.17.0. That makes deprecation (review) the right kind, not a mandatory-work kind. One small point: the proposed statement calls it an "environment variable", but the evidence calls it an agent option. That wording doesn't change the consequence kind or class.
